inputs.caption:
Hushed ASMR intimate close-mic rap, 79 BPM, D minor, velvet whispered delivery, paper-thin wall council flat story.
Vocal profile: Ultra-intimate close-mic whispering, rhythmic consonant click, warm proximity effect, dynamic hushed cadence.
Atmosphere: Council flat bedroom studio, fear of the ceiling broom tap, covert late-night creation.
inputs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(whispered ASMR tone, lips right on the capsule grille)
Shh... keep it down.
Mrs. Higgins in flat 4B has got super-hearing.
David Liniker, track thirteen... whispered stealth mode.

[Verse 1]
(ultra-close whisper-rap, crisp clicking consonants)
Paper-thin walls in this Victorian conversion
Any loud snare is a criminal excursion
If I drop a heavy kick or I belt out a chorus
Mrs. Higgins bangs her broom like a raging brontosaurus!
So I lean into the grille with a two-millimeter gap
Delivering the world's most intimate rap!
Velvet quiet cadence drifting through the air
Sounds like a confession in a midnight prayer!
Tabby’s walking on his tiptoes across the wooden floor
Ensuring that we don't disturb the tenant next door!

[Chorus]
(soft multi-layered whispered harmony, brushed drum beat)
Whispering in the mic so the neighbors don't complain
Turning quiet bedroom secrets into falling rain
Sometimes the softest voice carries furthest away
Speaking to the hearts that are waiting for the day!
Liniker whispering with passion in the dark...
Leaving our indelible mark!

[Verse 2]
Microphone gain cranked up to ninety-five
Capturing every breath that proves we're alive
You can hear the radiator clanking in the hall
You can hear the midnight shadows dancing on the wall
We turned our limitations to our greatest artistic grace
The quietest boom-bap in the human race!

[Chorus]
Whispering in the mic so the neighbors don't complain
Turning quiet bedroom secrets into falling rain
Sometimes the softest voice carries furthest away
Speaking to the hearts that are waiting for the day!
Liniker whispering with passion in the dark...
Leaving our indelible mark!

[Outro]
(quiet chuckle, muffled footsteps upstairs)
Shh... she’s turning over in bed.
Goodnight, Mrs. Higgins.
Liniker... stealth mode complete.
(microphone mute click)
